title: Gaza aid flotilla sets sail from Barcelona in bid to break Israeli blockade
summary: A flotilla of dozens of boats set sail for Gaza from Barcelona on Wednesday in a fresh bid to break an Israeli blockade and deliver aid supplies. Last year, another flotilla of about 50 boats was boarded by the Israeli navy, resulting in crew members, including Swedish activist Greta Thunberg, being arrested and expelled by Israel.

title: 苏丹战争三周年：古特雷斯呼吁结束冲突并加大人道主义支持
summary: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯周三在于柏林举行的苏丹问题国际人道主义会议上，通过视频致辞表示，苏丹战争已持续三年，这是一个悲剧性里程碑，冲突摧毁了一个充满希望的国家，并引发了世界上最大的人道主义危机。

title: 发展中国家启动“借款国平台” 聚焦债务协调与集体发声
summary: 周三，在国际货币基金组织与世界银行春季会议期间，发展中国家正式启动首个“借款国平台”，旨在交流知识、加强协调并在全球债务问题上发出集体声音。联合国贸易和发展会议将担任该平台秘书处。联合国秘书长古特雷斯在启动仪式上表示，这是“全球融资领域的突破”，为借款国提供了一个聚济一堂、相互学习并发出集体声音的平台。

title: 黎巴嫩局势持续升级 难民署呼吁保护平民并提供持续支持
summary: 联合国难民事务高级专员萨利赫周三在对黎巴嫩进行正式访问时表示，保护黎巴嫩境内的平民，以及向黎巴嫩政府主导下为应对大规模流离失所危机所进行的行动提供持续的国际支持，已刻不容缓。

title: 难民船在安达曼海倾覆致250人遇难失踪 移民组织表达关注
summary: 上周四，一艘载有罗兴亚难民和孟加拉国公民的船只在安达曼海倾覆，造成超过250人死亡或失踪。国际移民组织周三对该事表示关切。

title: Middle East conflict chokes end of supply chain as lights go out in the Pacific
summary: For Pacific Island countries, the Middle East crisis is not a distant geopolitical event. It is already showing up in higher fuel prices, electricity uncertainty and fears that communities sitting at the far end of global supply chains could be pushed into deeper economic insecurity.

title: ‘Sudan is an atrocities laboratory’, UN aid chief tells Berlin conference
summary: Foreign ministers from across the world met in Berlin on Wednesday to show support for Sudan, where a fourth year of brutal warfare has begun as humanitarian needs deepen.

title: MIDDLE EAST LIVE 15 April: Civilian dangers intensify as Israel expands Lebanon evacuation orders
summary: Across the Middle East, tensions remain high with Israeli military operations continuing in Lebanon following direct talks between the two governments in Washington on Tuesday.
